exposure: maternal short sleep duration during pregnancy
fetal glucose metabolism (cord blood C-peptide levels)
cohort: The study followed 7059 mother-child pairs from the Maternal & Infants Health in Hefei cohort.
finding: Maternal short sleep duration during pregnancy was significantly associated with an increased incidence of neurodevelopmental delay in offspring, especially in boys, an association that may be partly mediated by increased cord C-peptide levels.
